cues.name: date and time
cues.definition: When the photo was taken: a date, month, year, season, or a life period. Examples: 'exact date of the photo', 'specific date taken'. NOT when it was uploaded, backed up or synced; NOT when a feature changed or stopped working.

cues.name: location
cues.definition: Where the photo was taken: a place name, city, region, or a described place. Examples: 'location name - Pee Pee Township, Ohio', 'general location - New York City', 'location near a pier'. NOT where a file, folder or album sits inside the app; NOT the location of a setting or feature.

cues.name: person identity
cues.definition: A specific individual in or connected to the photo, by name or relationship, including named pets. Examples: "specific person's name (e.g. Abigail)", 'which people are tagged (Hans, Julia)', 'photos were taken by husband', "dog's name (Anubis)". NOT how the app groups or tags faces; NOT a person described only as the photo's subject matter.

cues.name: content description
cues.definition: What the photo shows: objects, animals, scenes, activities, or text visible inside the image. Examples: 'subject is sunrises', 'black and white dog in Hawaii', 'subject of photo (basketball goal)', 'exact text shown in the screenshot (KeroKero)'. NOT the named people in it; NOT where it was taken; NOT the occasion it belongs to.

cues.name: occasion or event
cues.definition: The event or occasion the photo belongs to: a trip, wedding, birthday, festival, or a described happening. Examples: 'moments/events of kids and other relevant things'. NOT the generic subject matter of the image; NOT a bare date.

cues.name: search term used
cues.definition: The literal word or phrase the person typed into search. Examples: "search keyword 'knife'", "search term 'golf'", "general subject keyword 'motorcycle'", "search term 'blowtorch'". This category is about the QUERY STRING ITSELF, not the attribute it refers to. A phrase belongs here only if it reports what was typed.

cues.name: album or folder name
cues.definition: The name of an album or folder the photo sits in, as the person recalls it. Examples: 'album/folder name', 'which album the photo belongs to'. NOT whether albums exist, how many there are, how recent they are, or whether their contents changed.

cues.name: file identity
cues.definition: Attributes of the file itself: its filename, extension, format, or size. Examples: 'filename with ABC_2022', "filename contains 'WA' from WhatsApp", 'specific words/strings contained in video filenames'. NOT the device that took it; NOT where it was uploaded from; NOT the photo's visual content.

cues.name: capture source
cues.definition: The device, camera or app that produced the photo, or where it was uploaded from. Examples: 'camera/device name', 'which app generated it', 'upload source distinction - pixel XL vs laptop'. NOT the filename; NOT the account, album or folder it ended up in.
